text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(All kinds of things happen!
Happy things, sad things...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Unexpected disasters, waves of information. We're always
living at the mercy of it all...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still, even so—!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I will rise again. I'll get back up and see it through!
Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Transcend achieves the first back-to-back
Champions Cup titles in history!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"No one can catch her! No one can pass her!
She has blown away all the pressure and threats
from her rivals completely—!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I—we...
have to win!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you lose.
Sometimes you get crushed.
Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: In the end, without fail...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Transceeeend!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Transcend, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they... watched me.
I wonder if it reached them...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
My phone...
Where's my phone...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, a-aaah...

I couldn't tell what was playing on the screen
of the smartphone she pulled out.
However—
"It must have reached them. Those overflowing feelings that can't be captured in mere words alone."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan...
choice_data_list: Congrats on the back-to-back victories, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, there are so many.
So many messages... came in...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Watching my race, they screamed, laughed,
cheered, and felt a real, true thrill."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Seeing that... I... couldn't stop shivering with excitement..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: There were lots of painful times, and sad times too. But—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "If I hadn't overcome that, I never would've reached these feelings, huh."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trai-chan.
For... teaching me how to race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For teaching me... how to live.
Man... I can't thank you enough.

Competing with many friends,
carrying so many hopes and wishes—

At the end of it, Transcend seemed to find
the unknown she had been searching for all along.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, Trai-chan... the camera.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Cinemagun ready.
Let's shoot the final scene.

I ready the video camera. All to capture the
valiant figure of my best friend who saw it through.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you for watching.
It turned into quite the unexpected recording, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's... one thing I noticed.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"That thrilling sensation isn't something
you can reach so easily."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Having someone who's giving it their all,
and carrying your own dreams and feelings for others
with absolute sincerity...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It means it won't happen unless we clash with everything we've got.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I don't think... this is where it ends.
I don't want it to end here.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I'm going. To meet all kinds of people—east, west, even to the desert kingdom."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So please watch over her running,
her battle... from right behind her.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"And lastly... Before I knew racing, I used to
think to myself: isn't life kind of boring?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Just another mediocre movie," they say.
But right now—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that at all.
As long as we're chasing after something, getting back up every time we fall, and moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Yes, life is full of ups and downs—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Because this cinema never ends!
